title: Introducing VIP Earn: Up to 20% Higher APR and Larger Quotas
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is pleased to announce the launch of  VIP Earn , a dedicated platform consolidating VIP yield products into a single entry point, backed by Binance security, offering 20% higher APR and 10x higher subscription quotas compared to standard Earn. Key Features of VIP Earn Dedicated VIP Hub:  Access all VIP-exclusive yield products, including  Simple Earn Locked ,  On-Chain Yield , and more, in one dedicated space on the Binance website and app.   Asset Security:  Assets remain within Binance custody during the subscription period, subject to applicable product terms and risk controls. Users no longer need to choose between asset security and earning opportunity. Higher Rates & Larger Quotas:  Enjoy exclusive up to 20% higher APR relative to retail Earn and up to 10x the subscription quota across 20+ tokens. Automatic Access:  All Binance VIP 1 - 9 users are automatically eligible. SAPI support is also available for API traders to manage positions programmatically.   Easy Identification:  Quickly identify VIP-exclusive products with a special tag across Earn listings, search results, and your portfolio.   VIP Earn is designed to help VIP users move idle balances into higher yield-generating opportunities, improving capital efficiency while adding another layer of value to the  Binance VIP Program .  How to Access VIP Earn You can start exploring VIP Earn by navigating to  [ Earn ] >  [VIP Earn]  on the Binance website or in the Binance App. Explore VIP Earn Eligibility: Full Access:  All Binance VIP 1 - 9 users have automatic access to VIP Earn and its exclusive products. View-Only Access:  Non-VIP users can browse the VIP Earn hub to see the exclusive rates and quotas available, giving them a preview of VIP benefits. To gain full access, users must become a  Binance VIP .
